Interface TrackedError.ThrowableSnapshot

Enclosing interface:
TrackedError
public static interface TrackedError.ThrowableSnapshot
A snapshot of a Throwable captured when an error is tracked.

The snapshot preserves the throwable's type, message, cause chain, and stack trace without retaining the original throwable.

Since:
0.30.0
